nodes.text: @RishikaSadam Diagnosis and Treatment: Healthcare providers may diagnose HMPV based on symptoms and health history. Laboratory tests, such as PCR (polymerase chain reaction) tests, can confirm the presence of the virus. There is no specific antiviral treatment for HMPV;

nodes.author: JaiKrishhhh
nodes.text:
@RishikaSadam Supportive care:
Drinking plenty of fluids
Taking over-the-counter medications to alleviate fever and pain
Using decongestants or cough suppressants. In severe cases, especially among high-risk groups, hospitalization may be necessary for oxygen therapy or intravenous fluids

nodes.author: JaiKrishhhh
nodes.text:
@RishikaSadam Prevention: Preventive measures include:

Washing hands frequently with soap and water
Avoiding close contact with individuals who are sick
Not touching the face with unwashed hands
Cleaning and disinfecting frequently touched surfaces
